project_title: DICOM-HUMap-BCRF: Box-Supervised Suspicion and Residual-Risk Mapping for Mammographic DICOM
acronym_definition: HUMap means Heatmap-Uncertainty Map; it does not mean Hounsfield units
scientific_task: Retrospective bbox-supervised localization of suspicious calcifications with suspicion and residual-risk maps

input.pixel_interpretation: stored full-precision presentation values after standard DICOM modality, VOI, polarity, masking, and valid-pixel normalization
input.preprocessing: single deterministic standard DICOM rendering contract

reference_standard.internal: radiologist bounding boxes for Suspicious Calcification
reference_standard.external: CBIS-DDSM ROI-mask DICOM converted to bounding boxes for evaluation only

primary_endpoint: conditional penalized IoU on bbox-bearing images, averaged within study_id and then across studies
classification_scope: Finding-presence classification is an auxiliary task and secondary diagnostic; it is not the primary novelty claim
hypothesis: A jointly optimized ResNet18-FPN hybrid that couples bbox-supervised center-size localization, zero-DC morphological context, adaptive scale reliability, and a learned residual-risk map can improve mean conditional localization performance over separately frozen saliency and rectangular-pseudomask comparators without manually assigned loss or fusion weights.
scientific_engineering_novelty: joint box-supervised prediction of suspicion, residual-risk, presence, count, and center-size geometry from standard-DICOM-preserving inputs
zero-DC learnable morphological context and adaptive scale-reliability fusion within the FPN decoder
parameter-free log1p-compressed multi-objective aggregation without manually fixed task weights
explicit evaluation of residual-risk as a predictor of localization error rather than treating it as a decorative confidence map
deployment-verified TorchScript artifacts with checkpoint-to-export state hashes and multi-input trace equivalence

comparators.threshold_provenance: frozen source artifacts; original selection partition cannot be reconstructed
comparators.claim_scope: comparisons apply to the current frozen implementations, not to entire method families

split_policy.validation: architecture, early stopping, checkpoint selection, and exploratory ablation evidence
split_policy.calibration: current-method heatmap and presence threshold selection after model freeze
split_policy.internal_retrospective: partition named locked_test in artifacts; historically inspected and not confirmatory
split_policy.confirmatory_locked_test: not available in the current evidence package

external_dataset.name: CBIS-DDSM Calc-Test
external_dataset.roi_mask_use: converted to external evaluation bounding boxes only; never used for model training or segmentation evaluation

blocking_conditions: promotion of checkpoint lineages not declared by the frozen model specification
known_limitations: the internal partition named locked_test was previously accessed and is retrospective
baseline threshold-selection provenance cannot be reconstructed
patient-level independence cannot be proven from available local identifiers
the frozen local annotation snapshot does not match the earlier source-manifest digest
target-negative local images contain other annotated findings and are not normal controls
the model predicts at most two boxes although a small number of images contain more than two annotated boxes
pixel masks are not model-training targets or segmentation-evaluation references; external CBIS-DDSM ROI masks are used only to derive evaluation bounding boxes
residual-risk output is not established as clinically calibrated uncertainty
claim_boundary: The accepted model is a scoped scientific-engineering contribution. Current evidence supports exploratory development and retrospective internal and external evaluation only; it does not establish clinical utility, patient-independent generalization, calibrated uncertainty, confirmatory superiority, state of the art, or universal superiority.
